subject: Final MAP freeze, signature timing and day-one anchor
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@brightcart.com>, Adam Weiss <adam.weiss@brightcart.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v3 + evaluation summary — request for final go/no-go and signature window

Hi Sara / Adam —

Thanks again for the productive evaluation sessions this week. Attached is the Mutual Action Plan (v3) and our completed evaluation checklist that summarizes perf, latency and integration notes from your team. High level: the model variant we tested meets your latency targets on 2 of 3 representative workloads; we've noted a short-tail performance gap on the personalization endpoint which we can address in the first-week tuning sprint.

Two asks to keep the schedule tight:
- Can BrightCart confirm a final go/no-go by Friday 2 Apr (end of day PST)?
- Can we target signature execution the week of 5 Apr — ideally Thu 8 Apr or Fri 9 Apr — so we can turn up staging and reserve the start slot for Mon 12 Apr.

Internal constraints from our side: we need VP Sales sign-off and Finance approval on the final SOW; Legal has flagged two minor redlines we discussed (data retention and audit log window). Those internal approvals are in-flight and I expect completion by EOD 1 Apr.

Attached: MutualActionPlan_v3.pdf, EvaluationChecklist.xlsx. I’ll send the SOW draft in a follow-up once legal review is in place. If you prefer DocuSign routing, we can prepare the envelope and share a link.

Simple next steps: confirm go/no-go date and preferred signature day. If those dates work, I’ll lock our staging window and share the DocuSign link.

Thanks —
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP v3 + evaluation summary — request for final go/no-go and signature window

Karthik —

Appreciate the summary and docs. Quick points from our side after an internal sync:
- Procurement (Adam) needs a final SOW for review and will try to clear commercial terms this week.
- Legal (Nigel) flagged SOC 2 evidence and a short audit log sample — can you share the SOC 2 letter and a short example of the audit logs?
- For scheduling: Apr 8 is tight for our C-level signoff, can we prioritize Apr 7 (Wed) for signatures instead? That gives us time for one last internal review on Mon/Tue.

If you can share the SOW and SOC2 letter by EOD Mon 29 Mar, I’ll push to get internal approvals aligned. Also confirm whether you will use DocuSign or we should route through our procurement portal.

Thanks —
Sara
VP Product, BrightCart
sara.gomez@brightcart.com
[cc: Adam Weiss (procurement), Nigel Price (legal)]

Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 10:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v3 + evaluation summary — request for final go/no-go and signature window

Sara / Adam / Nigel —

Confirmed: we can move the signature target to Wed 7 Apr. Internal status from Redwood: VP Sales (Marissa) has provisionally approved pricing, Finance has cleared the budget line, and Redwood Legal will complete the standard review by EOD Thu 1 Apr. I am attaching the SOW_Draft.docx (internal draft with the key commercial bullets) and our SOC 2 letter + audit-log sample link below.

DocuSign is easiest for us — I can assemble the envelope and share a pre-filled link once we have confirmation of signer names on your side. If BrightCart wants to route through procurement, we can accept that too, but may need the counterparty signing window adjusted by 24 hours for routing time.

Notes on launch cadence: to reduce early risk we propose a 2-day canary period in staging (12–13 Apr) and a controlled ramp to 100% traffic over 2 business days (14–15 Apr). That keeps the tuning sprint in the first week and leaves time for any immediate fallbacks.

Attachments / links: SOW_Draft.docx (docx), SOC2_letter_2026.pdf (pdf). DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/BRG-0421-signature

If this all looks good I’ll lock Wed 7 Apr for signature and reserve Mon 12 Apr as start. Please reply with signer names and any procurement portal link if you need us to push the envelope there.

Best —
Karthik
